_readme: Copy for Ochre's Requests and talk gift/trade stills in /workspace/qa/ui-declutter-mockup/ (requests.html, requests-empty.html, talk-gift-trade.html). Replaces every PLACEHOLDER. 'strings' are tokenised for Flint; 'stills' are the same strings filled for the seed-8 stand-in names Ochre used.

strings.requests.ask.scout_region: Spend a day at {regionName}, then come back.
strings.requests.ask.carry_word: Take word to {targetName}, and tell no other pride before that.
strings.requests.ask.find_cub: Find {cubName} at {regionName} and bring the cub home.
strings.requests.meta.due: Due by the end of the season
strings.requests.meta.failed.deadline: The season ended before you did this
strings.requests.meta.failed.third_pride: Another pride heard it before {targetName} did
strings.requests.line.branch.ql_bf06_somebody_li: You told {leaderName} you found it yourself.
strings.requests.empty.open: Nobody has asked you for anything yet.
strings.requests.empty.hint: Cats who like you, and leaders of prides that aren't hostile to you, may ask for your help. Saying yes is a promise. Saying no costs you nothing.
strings.gift.intro: Prey from the pride store, or the find you're carrying.
strings.gift.find.label: Carried find
strings.gift.hint.aggression: {catName} would like a trophy or a large kill. A herb might come across as an insult.
strings.gift.hint.sociability: {catName} would like prey shared where other cats can see. A trophy brought to the den would go down badly.
strings.gift.hint.curiosity: {catName} likes odd finds, like a bone or a herb, but not something you've brought before.
strings.gift.hint.none: {catName} would be glad of prey or a herb.
strings.trade.intro: Trades are agreements with a pride, struck at a council or by talking to a leader. Keeping a trade helps the standing between prides, and breaking it hurts. What you give leaves your pride's store. A trade never adds food.
strings.trade.food_for_passage.title: Food for safe passage
strings.trade.food_for_passage.body: You take a kill to their den. Your pride may cross their ground until the season ends.
strings.trade.food_for_passage.breaks: This breaks if you mark, hunt or fight there.
strings.trade.food_for_hunting.title: A large kill for hunting rights
strings.trade.food_for_hunting.body: You give a large kill now. Your pride may hunt {regionName}, on their ground, until the season ends.
strings.trade.food_for_hunting.breaks: This breaks if you hunt anywhere else of theirs.
strings.trade.help_for_help.title: A favour for a favour
strings.trade.help_for_help.body: You do a request for them. In return they scout a region for you, or drive off a hyena.
strings.trade.help_for_help.breaks: This breaks if either side fails its part.

parts.beat: You find Galestride at the Split Rock, lying on the warm side of the stone.
He lifts his head as your scent reaches him.

parts.say: There you are. I wondered if you'd come by today.

parts.beat: You sit down on the warm stone beside him.

parts.say: So what is it? You've either brought me something or you want something. Which?

choices: “I'd like to make a deal with your pride.”

notesForOchre: 'Step two of three' is gone: prose has no number words, so the line card shows pips (Director's deed-progress ruling) with the word kicker 'Quest line'.
The drive_off card said The Tar Seeps. The only hyena encounter in the build is at Twin Forks (encounter.cave_hyena.v1), so a drive_off should name Twin Forks.
Summercloud (mw04) is Mistwood, so her failed scout now names Reedbank instead of Greywater Ford.

The quest-line card is my Bonefield join line at its last step, so the asker is Rimerain (bf06 in seed 8) and the leader is Galestride (bf01 in seed 8). There's no bf06 head in portraits/, so neutral-head.png stands in. Galestride is Bonefield's leader in seed 8, so the Highcrag name tint on the talk still looks wrong.
The top-bar date 'Summer, the ninth day' uses an ordinal. Please use whatever the shipped date string is, or 'Midsummer' for the still.
The talk log is now four lines with no repeated arrival. The player's line moved into the choices, which answer his question.
Trade copy no longer has an em dash or the number word in 'one named region'.
